changes: Implemented decision-document promotion commands: proposal storage + Markdown rendering primitives; decision_doc_proposal / decision_doc_preview (read-only render) / decision_doc_save (with scope, freshness, and overwrite guards); registered in CLI, command policy, and process-fact contracts; added happy/edge/adversarial regression tests; doc updates for the implemented contract.

expectedOutcome: The three decision_doc_* commands appear in lattice help and enforce scope/freshness/overwrite guards; saved decision docs are governance/diagnostic material; validate passes with regression tests covering happy/edge/adversarial paths.
actualTranscript: lattice help lists decision_doc_preview / decision_doc_quorum_check / decision_doc_proposal / decision_doc_save; validate PASS @ 2026-06-15T21:25 (15/15 verification intents covered); merged 699 commits of main (6 conflicts in registration files resolved as additive union; build green).
outcomeDiff: Expected == actual after merging main: commands register and pass validation; the plan-doc wording was reconciled to the current review-escalation model (decision-doc edits are classification-only unless the first-round threshold triggers escalation).
limitations: Review escalation not required (clean first review round). Merged a 699-commit main divergence; conflict resolution kept both the decision-doc-promotion and review-escalation registrations (union).
pitfalls: decision_doc_save guards (scope/freshness/overwrite) must not be bypassed; saved decision docs are diagnostic/governance material, not an automatic DONE-gate trigger unless the review-escalation threshold fires.
